title: Erdős 251 finite dyadic partial-sum successor laws

concepts.label: finite dyadic successor step
concepts.note: The exact last-term increment for ordinary and forward-difference dyadic partial sums.

concepts.label: finite-sum authority boundary
concepts.note: The identities are exact finite algebra; they supply no convergence, recurrence instantiation, or irrationality conclusion.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: Increasing the cutoff from n to n+1 adds exactly P(n)/2^(n+1) to the finite dyadic partial sum, and adds exactly (P(n+1)-P(n))/2^(n+1) to its forward-difference partial sum.
statement_nodes.engine: The exact Finset sum-range successor identity applied to the two finite rational sums.
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Routine finite-sum recurrences used by the subsequent exact summation-by-parts theorem.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: These identities concern arbitrary finite rational sequences. They do not prove summability of the prime or prime-gap series, identify an infinite tail, or settle Erdős 251.
